title: Testing with Vitest and Vue Test Utils

videos.script:
The planner has been checked by eye for twenty lessons, with look and a transcript. Today it gets tests that check it by themselves, every time anything changes. {{install}} First Vitest, a test runner that is Vite running tests, and two packages beside it.

{{pure}} Then the planner's rules, the plain functions of lesson 3, which are the cheapest code there is to test. You will break one of them the way a tidy refactoring would, and watch the one test written for Sundays catch it.

{{mount}} Then a component mounted on its own, {{interact}} and a form filled in the way a student fills it. {{store}} Then the store, with the network replaced by an answer the test chooses, and a watcher whose timing becomes part of the test.

{{async}} Then the week page on a clock the test sets, and midnight, tested in a tenth of a second. {{what}} And last, what is worth testing and what is not.
